article_notes: 15 dogs with uncomplicated B. canis babesiosis (smear and PCR, Poland) compared with 7 healthy dogs. All infected dogs were uncomplicated and all recovered, so there is no severity or outcome split. Every comparison (WBC, RBC, Ht, PLT per dog; Cu, Zn, SOD, CAT, GSH with Mann-Whitney) is infected vs healthy and was not extracted. The 18S strain A vs B typing was not compared with any severity measure (the discussion says no correlation of strain with SOD, CAT, GSH, which is not a severity comparison). Setting is a faculty clinic; samples taken before any treatment.
